snippet.title: Retro Arcade Shop Simulator - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
🕹️ Create your dream Retro Arcade Shop! Arriving on PC in Early Access on September 4, 2026: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4010900/Retro_Arcade_Shop_Simulator/

Start with a small arcade and grow it into a sprawling gaming complex with up to 10 rooms. Buy and place classic arcade cabinets, pinball machines, claw machines, and air hockey tables, then expand with an 8D cinema, pool tables, racing simulators, a bowling alley, or even a go-kart track, with over 25 unique machines and attractions in total. 

Manage a token economy, take out bank loans, service your machines, and hire staff to keep everything running. Run a cafeteria, sell games and magazines, and customize every wall, floor, sign, and neon in your venue.

#RetroArcadeShopSimulator #Arcade #Simulator
